assessment: A softens the temporal fold most clearly in the fixed late-blink macro, but it introduces measured skin self-overlap. B reduces the larger normal step at one outer corner and increases the other. The fixed frontal, turned, oblique, and profile views show the angular closure line persists, with no net appearance gain at normal head scale. The conforming patch is reusable construction only.
nextAction: Keep r500 B as the working model and preserve the finite-tested conforming front-margin method. Retire smoothing the same inherited fold as the immediate appearance path. Review the crown-to-temple hair volume from the matched complete views and rebuild the sheet-like groups as smaller coherent full-length locks with independent silhouette and root-to-tip flow. Keep the eyelid evidence for a later motion redesign.

resources.initialAuthor: The first attempt ended before any save because BMesh invalidated a face while copying custom data. The successful author assigns the original material and independently restores UVs and inherited normals.
resources.firstReopen: A syntax error prevented the first verifier from launching its scene. A later check found a driven split point more than 12 micrometres from its parent centroid. The final check records the measured offsets and tests the exact face geometry.
resources.previewAdmission: Two admission checks saw low Windows commit headroom, so no renderer started in those attempts. A bounded admission poll detected recovery and one renderer finished 20 views.
